Yes. I found several Toronto/GTA marketing providers with publicly posted pricing, including some in the ~$400–$1,000/month range. I’d separate them by what you actually get rather than treating “cheap” as automatically better.

Provider	Published starting price	Main service	What’s included / notable
Page Pros	$999/mo + $500 setup	Social media	2 platforms, 2 posts/week, content writing, scheduling, reporting; no contract. 
Page Pros

White Petals Agency	$499/mo	PPC or SEO	PPC: 2 ad channels, ad designs, landing page, tracking. SEO: 25 keywords/pages, analytics, 1 blog, backlinks. No setup fee. 
White Petals Agency

Blab Media	$500/mo	Social media	Up to 8 posts/month, captions, basic engagement monitoring, audit/profile optimization, monthly performance snapshot. 3-month minimum. 
Blab Media

Keystroke Quality Designs	$300/mo	PPC/SEM	Suitable for $500–$1,000 ad spend; 4 creative variations, 4 ads, 2 hours campaign management, tracking and reporting. Setup fee applies. 
Keystroke Quality Designs

Databending	$300/mo	SEO	Monthly reporting; also publishes one-off SEO services such as $500 keyword research and $750 competitor research. 
Databending

Marketing AI	$500/mo management	Paid social/Google	Example package: $1,000 ad spend + $500 management, with $250 setup. Landing pages and remarketing included in some packages. 
Marketing AI
A few observations

If you're primarily after social media: Blab Media's $500 package is one of the lower-priced Toronto options I found with a reasonably clear deliverable list. It includes 8 posts/month, whereas Page Pros starts at $999/month. 
Blab Media
+1

If you're after SEO: Databending is unusually transparent about individual SEO tasks—e.g. $500 for 50-keyword research, $750 for 100 keywords, and $300/month for reporting. That can make sense if you don't need a conventional full-service retainer. 
Databending

If you're trying to generate leads through ads: Keystroke's published $300/month SEM tier is notably inexpensive, although you also need to account for the advertising budget and setup fee. Their next tier is $550/month. 
Keystroke Quality Designs

If you want an all-in-one package: White Petals publishes a $499/month PPC package and a $499/month SEO package, but the deliverables and advertising budget should be examined carefully before comparing it directly with social-media packages. 
White Petals Agency

One important caveat: these aren't apples-to-apples prices. A $300 PPC management fee doesn't mean $300 total marketing spend—you still pay the ad platforms. Likewise, social packages differ substantially in content volume, video, community management, strategy, and reporting.

If you tell me your monthly budget (e.g. $500, $1,000, or $1,500) and whether you need SEO, Google/Meta ads, social media, or a combination, I can narrow this to a more useful Toronto shortlist and compare the actual deliverables side-by-side.
